title: nitpick.config.json
description: Configuration for nitpick-notes, the local server for the nitpick Chrome extension. Every key is optional. This schema is for editor autocomplete only; the server validates the file itself.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor support.

outputDir.description: Directory (relative to the project root) where session folders are written. If nitpick creates it, it adds a .gitignore so sessions are not committed by default.

port.description: Port for the standalone server (`npx nitpick`). Ignored by the Vite plugin, which uses Vite's port.

host.description: Interface the standalone server binds to. Keep this on loopback: the server writes files to disk. Anything else logs a warning.

token.description: Optional shared secret. When set, the extension must send it in the x-nitpick-token header. Enter the same value in the extension settings.

maxUploadBytes.description: Maximum size of a single uploaded screenshot or recording, in bytes. Default 200 MiB.

sessionTitle.description: Default title (the H1 of notes.md) for new sessions.

allowedOrigins.description: Extra web origins allowed to call the API, e.g. "http://localhost:3000". chrome-extension:// origins are always allowed. Exact origins only: no wildcards, paths, or trailing slashes.
